description: Footstep sounds by place on map2_s00 (Old Silent Hill - streets). After the character's own footsteps table, every rule of "places" whose conditions all hold replaces the step sound, in file order, so the last match wins. Conditions (each optional): "surface" / "not_surface" (surface names of gamedata/world/surfaces.json), "room" (the map's room index), "x" / "z" ([min, max] of the player's position in metres, inclusive, null = open), "y_above" (metres; the player's y is greater, y grows downwards). They test the player's position for every character's step, as the original did. "sound" is a sound name of gamedata/sounds; "name" identifies the rule (on_footstep scripts see it as e.place, and a mod's maps/map2_s00/footsteps.json replaces or adds rules by name). Here a wooden spot of the Old Town streets (x 95..105 m, z -33..-28 m) sounds like planks.
